[/i][/font][/center]This simple mod features an expanded portrait sheet for the wizard in the style of Gigi's portraits, designed for compatibility with the Romanceable Rasmodius mod.

Originally created for personal use, but shared here to aid others who wish to romance Rasmodius with Chaekal's young wizard design. 


[center][b]﻿Portraiture[/b] - Framework required to replace character portraits.
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999[/url]﻿[/center]
[center][b]Gigi's Portrait Mod[/b] - Source of original 2 expression portrait sheet. Download for matching portraits for all other characters.
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759[/url]﻿﻿

[b]Chaekal-Rizum Wizard Sprites[/b] - Use the sprites from here to match the portraits. Compatible with Romanceable Rasmodius.
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3226]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3226

[/url][b]Romanceable Rasmodius[/b] - Go date and marry the wizard boy :)
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073[/url]﻿﻿[/center]
Special thanks to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4103]Lilico's edits for Looking for Love[/url], which inspired me to create this sheet!

[b]INSTALLATION :[/b]
1. Extract "RR Gigi Wizard Portrait Sheet.zip"
2. Place "RRWizard.png" in "Portraiture > Portraits > [folder (ex. Gigi)]"
3. Rename "RRWizard.png" to "Wizard.png" to overwrite the existing wizard file
4. In the Romanceable Rasmodius mod folder, edit the "config.json" file so the Portrait line reads: [b]"Portrait": "custom"[/b]
(If you're using the matching body sprites, set "Sprite" to custom as well!)
5. Profit :)
